title: Determination of Protein Levels of Browning Genes in Murine Adipose Tissues by Western Blotting
author: Bianca Hemmeryckx
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kbfcsjn
materials: Unpack the NUPAGE 10% Bis-Tris gel and remove the white plastic strip at the bottom and comb. 10-well NUPAGE 10% Bis-Tris gel Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #NP0301BOX 12-well NUPAGE 10% Tris-Bis gel Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #NP0302BOX
Use the Blotting roller to eliminate air bubbles.

Detect UCP-1 and PGC-1α with SuperSignal™ West Femto Maximum Sensitivity Substrate. -Mix equal volumes of reagent 1 and 2 (1 ml in total), cover tube with tinfoil. -Place the membrane in transparent foil. -Incubate with substrate mixture. -Expose to chemiluminescence (lumi-imager, Chemidoc XRS+ Image Lab™ Software, 1708265 ,Bio-Rad). SuperSignal™ West Femto Maximum Sensitivity Substrate Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #34095

Strip membrane for re-blotting (Re-Blot Plus Mild antibody stripping solution). -Wash away substrate for 15 min in TBST. -Incubate the membrane in 5 ml stripping buffer (1X in MilliQ water) for 15 min at room temperature. -Wash shortly in TBST. Re-Blot Plus Mild antibody stripping solution Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #2502

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer and add to tissue
steps.instruction: Make 10 ml of protein lysis buffer RL by mixing 1 ml 100 mM Na₂PO₄ (10 mM) / 1.5 M NaCl (0.15 M), 400 µl 25 % Triton‑X‑100 (final 1 %), 100 µl 10 % SDS (0.1 %), 1 ml 5 % sodium deoxycholate (0.5 %), 1 ml 2 % sodium azide (0.2 %), and 6.5 ml MilliQ water; add fresh EDTA to 1 / 100 v/v and HALT phosphatase‑protease inhibitor cocktail (100×, Thermo Fisher #78442). Add buffer to each tissue sample in a 1.5 ml tube with glass beads at a volume equal to tissue weight (mg) × 4 µl.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue samples
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a Fastprep Ribolyser (MP Biomedicals) and run at speed 6 for 40 s, repeat once (total two cycles) keeping the tubes on ice between cycles.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenates at 13 000 rpm for 20 min at +4 °C, then transfer the clear supernatant to a new labeled Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Determine protein concentration (BCA assay)
steps.instruction: Use the Pierce BCA Protein Assay (Thermo Fisher #23225) as follows: (1) Prepare a BSA standard curve (2 mg/ml stock) with concentrations 1 mg/ml, 500 µg/ml, 250 µg/ml, 125 µg/ml, 62.5 µg/ml, 31.25 µg/ml, 15.625 µg/ml, 7.8125 µg/ml, diluting with MilliQ water; (2) Dilute each protein extract 1/50 and 1/100 in MilliQ water; (3) Pipette 50 µl of each standard and each diluted sample (in duplicate) into a 96‑well plate; (4) Prepare BCA working reagent by mixing reagent A and reagent B at a 50:1 ratio and add 200 µl to each well; (5) Incubate the plate 30 min at room temperature in the dark; (6) Measure absorbance at 550 nm on a Biotek ELx808IU plate reader using Gen5 software; (7) Calculate and average the protein concentrations for each sample. BSA (2 mg/ml) catalog #23209.

steps.title: Prepare samples for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: For each lane, combine 50 µg of protein with enough MilliQ water to reach a total of 12 µl (for a 12‑well gel) or 25 µl (for a 10‑well gel), then add the appropriate volume of 4× NuPAGE LDS Sample Buffer (Thermo Fisher #NP0007) containing β‑mercaptoethanol at a 20:1 ratio (buffer:β‑ME).

steps.title: Assemble gel apparatus and fill buffer
steps.instruction: Mount the gel cassette in the X‑Cell SureLock running tank (Life Technologies). Fill the tank with 1× NuPAGE MOPS SDS Running Buffer (prepared from the 20× concentrate, Thermo Fisher #NP0001) and supplement with 500 µl NuPAGE Antioxidant (Thermo Fisher #NP0005).

steps.title: Denature samples
steps.instruction: Heat the prepared protein samples at 95 °C for 5 min in a heat block.

steps.title: Load gel and run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load each denatured sample and 8 µl of PageRuler Prestained Protein Ladder (10–180 kDa, orange 70 kDa, green 10 kDa, Thermo Fisher #26616) into the wells. Close the tank, connect the Powerease 500 power supply (Thermo Fisher), and run the gel under the appropriate voltage/current settings.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to nitrocellulose (iBlot)
steps.instruction: Assemble the iBlot transfer stack on the iBlot Gel Transfer Device (IB1001, Thermo Fisher): place the NC anode stock bottom‑mini (04‑BLT‑BM‑UN002), the gel (pre‑soaked in deionized water), iBlot filter paper, and the cathode stock top‑mini (06‑BLT‑BM‑UN001) containing a nitrocellulose membrane (Thermo Fisher #IB301001). Position the disposable sponge with metal contact on the upper right corner of the lid, close the lid, and latch it (red light indicates a closed circuit). Select program P1 (25 V, 6 min) and press Start/Stop (red light turns green). After the run, disassemble the stack and remove the membrane.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Incubate the nitrocellulose membrane in TBST (1×) containing 5 % Blotting‑Grade Blocker (milk, Bio‑Rad #170‑6404) on a shaker at room temperature for 2–3 h. TBST is prepared from 10× TBS (1 L: 24 g Tris base, 88 g NaCl, pH 7.6, bring to 1 L) mixed with 0.5 ml Tween‑20 (final 0.05 %) and diluted to 1 L with water.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibodies (UCP‑1 & PGC1α)
steps.instruction: Prepare two primary antibody solutions in TBST + 5 % milk: (a) rabbit anti‑mouse polyclonal UCP‑1, 1 / 2000, with 5 % BSA (Fraction V, Roche #10735086001); (b) rabbit anti‑mouse polyclonal PGC1α, 1 / 4000, with 5 % milk. Cover the membrane with each antibody solution (or combine as appropriate) and incubate overnight at +4 °C on a shaker.

steps.title: Wash membrane after primary incubation
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane 3 times for 5 min each with TBST (1×) on a shaker.

steps.title: Incubate with HRP secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Apply HRP‑conjugated goat anti‑rabbit IgG (1 / 2000) diluted in TBST + 5 % milk (catalog #P0448) and incubate for 1 h at room temperature on a shaker.

steps.title: Wash membrane after secondary incubation
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane 3 times for 5 min each with TBST (1×).

steps.title: Re‑block and probe housekeeping proteins
steps.instruction: Re‑block the membrane in TBST + 5 % milk for 2–3 h as before, then incubate with the following primary antibodies: (a) rabbit monoclonal anti‑mouse β‑actin (13E5), 1 / 1000, for 1.5 h at room temperature in TBST + 5 % milk (Cell Signaling #4970L); (b) rabbit monoclonal anti‑mouse GAPDH, 1 / 2000, overnight at +4 °C in TBST + 5 % milk (Cell Signaling #2118L). Continue with the same HRP‑goat anti‑rabbit secondary antibody incubation and washing steps as described above.
